claim: FL Europe store-locator census on 2026-10-07: 556 unique store IDs across 14 country sites (IT 154, FR 140, DE 79, UK 49, ES 46, NL 22, BE 15, PL 12, PT 9, CZ 9, AT 6, LU 6, IE 5, HU 4). The total is close to DKS's 559 Europe owned stores at 8/1/26. stores.footlocker.dk/.se/.no/.ch do not resolve.
data_point: 556 unique IDs on the verifier recount (scraper had 558; PT 9 vs 11). Includes about 4 hidden closures (all days closed) and some 6xxxx alias IDs, so the true open count is lower.
verifier_note: Recounted all 14 sitemaps live on 2026-10-07 and got 556, not 558. Only the PT count differs (now 9: 7704, 7705, 7708, 7713, 7715, 7717, 7718, 7811, 7814). Downgraded to B: the total only restates the known 559, and the new part is the per-country split.

claim: Wayback-vs-live locator diff: about 30 distinct European FL store pages that showed life after 2025-09-01 have since been removed from the company locator (they now 301 to the city index) or set to all-days-closed. Country split: UK 4, DE 6, FR 5, ES 3-4, NL 3, IT 2, BE 2, HU 2, PT 2, PL 1. Named May-Oct 2026 cases: Fulda, Hamburg AEZ, Metz, Chatham, Avignon, Lyon Confluence, Ulm Blautal, Czestochowa.
source_name: Wayback Machine CDX + live FL locator (computed)
verifier_note: Every last-live date I re-checked in CDX matched the scraper (DE, UK, ES, NL, BE, PT), and the live 301s for the Louvain, Mammut and Vaci pages were confirmed. The 'post-deal' tag needs a caveat: the locator lags real closures by months. GranCasa 7115 stayed live until 2026-02-14 but the store closed around June 2025, before the deal. ES should therefore be 3, not 4 (total about 30). The last-live date bounds when the store left the locator, not when it closed. Only a sample was verified, not all ~30 rows.

claim: Hidden closures: four FL Europe stores are still in the company locator but have all 7 days set to 'closed' in their hours JSON. They are Avignon 9 rue des Marchands (FR 5107), Lyon 112 cours Charlemagne / Confluence (FR 5305), Ulm Blaubeurer Str. 95 / Blautal-Center (DE 3187) and Czestochowa Galeria Jurajska (PL 13015).
data_point: 4 locator pages with 7/7 days 'closed' (scraper said 5; the 5th, Aulnay 65132, is an alias ID of store 5132, which is still listed)
verifier_note: Fetched all four pages live on 2026-10-07: each window.hours primary block has every day set to 'closed'. Control: an open store (Aix-en-Provence 5146) shows normal 10:00-19:00 hours, so all-closed is not a template default. Avignon is independently confirmed closed 2026-09-16 (InfoAvignon). Lyon, Ulm and Czestochowa have no press corroboration. I excluded Aulnay 65132 as an alias ID, since the main 5132 page is still in the sitemap.

claim: ECE (Germany's largest mall operator) has removed Foot Locker from its directories at Alstertal-Einkaufszentrum Hamburg, Forum Wetzlar and pep Muenchen-Neuperlach: /shops/foot-locker/ returns 404, while control ECE centres where FL trades (Regensburg Arcaden, MyZeil) return 200. The FL locator pages for the same stores were last live 2026-05-16, 2026-02-18 and 2025-10-07.
data_point: 3 ECE mall exits after the deal; landlord 404s plus FL locator removals; FL is absent from each centre's A-Z shop list
original_quote: Entschuldigung Die Seite, die du suchst, scheint nicht zu existieren.
english_translation: Sorry, the page you are looking for does not seem to exist.
verifier_note: Live check 2026-10-07: AEZ, Wetzlar and pep return 404; Regensburg Arcaden and MyZeil return 200 and contain 'Foot Locker'. Regensburg's A-Z list shows 'Foot Locker' between Fielmann and Fotofix, while the Wetzlar list runs Deichmann, Depot, DERTOUR... with no FL. Wayback CDX confirms the FL locator last-live dates (3184 2026-05-16; 3301 2026-02-18; 3339 2025-10-07). The scraper also cites a mittelhessen.de Facebook post saying FL left Forum Wetzlar; my fetch of it failed (timeout/400), so that corroboration is unverified.

claim: Max Center, Barakaldo (Bizkaia): Foot Locker is closing its 'flagship' store, which has 12 employees. The ELA union agreement allows only voluntary exits, paid at unfair-dismissal (despido improcedente) severance rates.
data_point: 12 staff; voluntary exits only at despido improcedente severance; locator store 17217 last live 2025-11-12, now removed
original_quote: Cierran la tienda insignia de Foot Locker en el Centro Comercial Max Center donde trabajan 12 personas.
english_translation: Foot Locker's flagship store in the Max Center shopping centre, where 12 people work, is closing.
verifier_note: Page is live, dated 09/02/2026, headed 'Cierre de Foot Locker - Max Center de Barakaldo'. The quote is verbatim, and the page also says 'no habrá salidas forzosas' and 'un total de 12 trabajadoras'. Wayback confirms store 17217 (Barrio Kareaga s/n) last live 2025-11-12. The ~33 days/yr severance rule is outside knowledge of Spanish law, not from the source.

claim: Avignon, 9 rue des Marchands: Foot Locker permanently closed its city-centre store on 2026-09-16. Regional FL managers confirmed the closure and attributed it to FL's 'international restructuring' and, above all, falling sales. FL stays at Mistral 7 and Aushopping Avignon Nord (Le Pontet). The store is still listed in the locator with all days closed.
data_point: Closure 2026-09-16 (after the 559 count at 8/1/26); 2 Avignon-area stores remain
original_quote: Cette fermeture s'inscrit dans le cadre de la restructuration internationale engagée par Foot Locker, mais s'explique aussi, et surtout, par la baisse du chiffre d'affaires enregistrée par le magasin du centre-ville.
english_translation: This closure is part of the international restructuring undertaken by Foot Locker, but is also, and above all, explained by the fall in sales at the city-centre store.
verifier_note: Article is live: published 2026-09-14, updated 2026-09-16. The headline quote is verbatim. The article says the information came from Vaucluse Matin and was confirmed by the chain's regional managers. Corroborated by locator page FR 5107 showing all days closed.

claim: Pentagon Centre, Chatham (owned by Medway Council): Foot Locker shut its store in the week of 20 July 2026. A Medway Council spokesperson said terms are being agreed with new occupiers.
data_point: Shut week of 2026-07-20; locator store 4215 last live 2026-03-05, now removed
original_quote: Footwear brand Foot Locker shut its prominent store at the beginning of this week, marking a major loss for the shopping centre.
verifier_note: Article is live and dated 22 July 2026. Both the quote and the council line ('terms are currently being agreed with new occupiers') are verbatim. Wayback confirms pentagon-centre 4215 last live 2026-03-05. This is consistent with the UK accounts' 2026 plan of 3 approved closures already in confirmed/B_w1 (one more data point, not a duplicate).

claim: Fulda, Bahnhofstrasse 5: Osthessen-News reported on 2026-05-17 that the store had only days left. Staff were reportedly looking for new jobs and the space might have to be vacated by 20 May. The FL locator page was removed after 2026-04-15.
data_point: Expected closure ~2026-05-20; locator 3350 last live 2026-04-15, now removed
original_quote: Foot Locker schließt! Filiale in der Bahnhofstraße nur noch wenige Tage geöffnet
english_translation: Foot Locker is closing! Bahnhofstrasse branch open only a few more days.
verifier_note: Article is live, datePublished 2026-05-17, headline verbatim. An employee is quoted saying the branch would be open 'nicht mehr wirklich lange' (not much longer). The 20 May date is reported as circulating hints, not as fact, so the exact closure date is unconfirmed. Locator removal confirmed via Wayback and the live sitemap.

claim: Osnabrück, Grosse Strasse 6: HASEPOST reported on 2026-03-09 that Foot Locker had closed its Osnabrück store, with the windows empty and no successor tenant. The article links it to integration and network realignment under DKS.
data_point: Store closed by 2026-03-09; locator ID 3218 removed
original_quote: Hinweise auf einen Nachfolger für die Fläche gibt es derzeit nicht.
english_translation: There are currently no indications of a successor for the space.
verifier_note: Article is live, published 2026-03-09, quote verbatim, photo caption 'Geschlossen: Foot Locker in Osnabrück'. The DKS link in the article is generic context, not a company statement. The FL locator's last Wayback capture is from 2024-05, so the closure date could be earlier than the article, and post-deal timing is not proven.

claim: Country-level shrinkage in the FL locator since 2024: NL from about 30 to 22 store IDs, HU from 6 to 4 (Budapest Mammut and Vaci utca 14 removed after Nov/Dec 2025), BE from 19 to 15 (incl. Kortrijk after 2025-11-13 and Klépierre's L'esplanade Louvain-la-Neuve after 2026-04-11). PT has lost Vila Nova de Gaia (after 2025-09-12) and Lisbon Rua do Carmo (after 2026-02-13).
data_point: Live 2026-10-07: NL 22, HU 4 (13802, 13803, 13804, 13807), BE 15, PT 9. Removed with post-deal last-live dates: Utrecht 1148 (2026-04-19), Haarlem 1209 (2026-02-15), Hoofddorp 1146 (2025-11-15), Kortrijk 2122, Louvain-la-Neuve 2129, Lisbon 7703, Gaia 17710, Mammut 13808, Vaci 13851
verifier_note: Live counts recomputed. I checked Wayback last-live dates for NL, BE and PT and they match. Mammut and Vaci now 301 to the Budapest index (their CDX lookups timed out, so those dates are unverified). Several removals counted in the shrinkage predate the deal (Leuven, Namur, Hasselt Jan 2025; several NL Apr 2025), and Amsterdam Nieuwendijk may be a relocation. The HU exit/licensing candidacy is inference. Klépierre ownership of L'esplanade is the scraper's background knowledge.

claim: Liverpool ONE (Landsec): Foot Locker is relocating its Liverpool flagship into the 68,000 sq ft former Topshop on Church Street, a post-deal lease commitment at a prime UK scheme. The new store is now live in the locator as ID 4448 at 22-36 Church St.
data_point: Locator 4448 'LIVERPOOL 1 SC, UNIT 2 22-36 CHURCH ST, PETERS LN, L1 3AW' live with full trading hours
original_quote: Foot Locker will relocate its Liverpool-based flagship to the 68,000 sq ft former Topshop outlet on Church Street, part of Liverpool One shopping centre.
verifier_note: Drapers page is live (published 2025-12-03), and the headline and standfirst match. The article body is paywalled, so the Rob Deacon (Landsec) quote and the '59 UK stores' figure could not be verified. Locator page 4448 is live with Mon-Fri 10-8, Sat 10-7, Sun 11-5 hours. FL may occupy only part of the 68,000 sq ft (ground floor per the scraper).

claim: Counter-evidence: core landlord directories still list Foot Locker (ECE Regensburg Arcaden, ECE MyZeil Frankfurt, Klépierre Belle Épine/Thiais). Several locator 'removals' appear to be same-mall relocations or renumbers (e.g. Casamassima, Aprilia, Arese, Nola, Modena, Regensburg, Portet, Madrid Plenilunio, Madrid Preciados), which points to continued refit capex at A-malls.
data_point: 3 landlord control pages return 200 and list FL
source_name: Klépierre / ECE mall directories + FL locator
original_quote: Foot Locker Thiais : horaires, accès et bons plans - Belle Épine
english_translation: Foot Locker Thiais: opening hours, access and offers - Belle Épine
verifier_note: All three control pages return 200 and mention Foot Locker. The relocation/renumber pairs were inferred from store-number patterns (+100 or 6xxxx aliases); I did not check them one by one. Downgraded to C: that some A-malls stay open is expected and does not by itself show new investment.
